d: Addressing journalists at the annual Diwali Milan gathering, Prime Minister Narendra Modi recounted his long-standing relationship with the media, spanning from the era of fax machines and press releases to instant reels and digital channels. Highlighting the evolution of communication technology, he observed that mobile phones have turned into news vans, multiplying platforms and viewpoints across democracy. Underscoring that newsrooms operate strictly on deadlines, he stressed that the nation is likewise functioning with a clear deadline to achieve developed status by 2047. Citing…
